messages.subject: Bug: UNPROTECT(9) in viterbiC_clonalCN.c
messages.body_plain:
Hi!

I've just discovered a tiny bug in viterbiC_clonalCN.c line 131 (https://github.com/gavinha/TitanCNA/blob/977c48a0b17e700d1f36750fabcc0cff8d773bdf/src/viterbiC_clonalCN.c): According to https://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-devel/R-exts.html#Garbage-Collection, UNPROTECT(n) unprotects the last n objects which were protected. The function viterbiC_clonalCN at first protects the 9 input arguments. However, in line 86 the return variable path_data is also protected. As a result, UNPROTECT(9) doesn't unprotect the 9 input arguments, but unprotects the return variable path_data and the last eight input arguments.

Cheers,
Jonas
